items.title: Quad9 (DNS Resolver) to Exit France
items.title_zh: Quad9因藐视法庭裁决将把DNS解析服务撤出法国
items.title_en: Quad9 to Pull Its DNS Resolver Out of France After Contempt Ruling
items.summary: Quad9 is pulling its DNS resolution service out of France after a court held it in contempt for failing to block pirated content, even though the rights holder circumvented its geoIP measures with a VPN.

items.title: Getting ready to operate GNU Taler in Germany
items.title_zh: GNU Taler 筹备在德国正式投入运营
items.title_en: GNU Taler prepares for operational rollout in Germany
items.summary: GNU Taler, a privacy-preserving electronic payment system, is preparing for operational deployment in Germany, prompting discussion about its design trade-offs and its prospects against bank-backed rivals like Wero.

items.title: Jailbreaking the Switch 2
items.title_zh: 借助LLM自动化与JetKVM硬件，Switch 2被成功破解
items.title_en: Switch 2 jailbroken via LLM-driven automation with JetKVM and Bluetooth switch
items.summary: A detailed account of jailbreaking the Switch 2 using an LLM-assisted, hardware-automated setup involving JetKVM and a Bluetooth-controlled power button.

items.title: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business
items.title_zh: eMudhra 因私钥被破解退出全球 SSL/TLS 证书业务
items.title_en: eMudhra Exits Global SSL/TLS Certificate Business After Private Key Failures
items.summary: eMudhra announced it is withdrawing from the global SSL/TLS certificate business following a security incident and intense scrutiny from browser vendors and the community.

items.title: 研究：智能电视关掉内容识别仍在上报
items.title_zh: 研究：智能电视关闭内容识别后仍继续上报数据
items.title_en: Study: Smart TVs Keep Reporting ACR Data Even After Users Turn It Off
items.summary: A study found that some smart TVs continue reporting content-recognition data even after ACR is disabled, with two platforms transmitting viewing information unencrypted.

items.title: Nvidia 禁运 B300 芯片现身中国国有网络
items.title_zh: 被禁运的 Nvidia B300 芯片据称现身中国国有网络
items.title_en: Banned Nvidia B300 Chips Reportedly Found in Chinese State-Owned Network
items.summary: A report claims that banned Nvidia B300 chips have surfaced in a Chinese state-owned network via a ¥3B server deal, with paperwork allegedly redacted after regulators took notice, prompting Nvidia and ASUS to respond.

items.title: 商务部对人工智能、生物医药、光伏相关技术出口实施临时登记  商务部拟修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》。
items.title_zh: 商务部拟对人工智能、生物医药、光伏技术实施出口管制并公开征求意见
items.title_en: China's MOFCOM Proposes Export Controls on AI, Biotech and Solar Tech
items.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce is soliciting public comment on revisions to its prohibited/restricted technology export catalog, adding temporary registration for 40 technologies across AI, biotech, and photovoltaics, with carve-outs for already-public AI work and for non-transfer biotech licensing.
